note: V90Phase2Info.cpp is the constructor and `printInfo`.  The constructor is five copies, and two of them TEST the parameter rather than carrying it -- `cmpl $0x0` then `setne` -- so the mutation that matters is the one that turns a test back into a copy.  It is caught only because the test sweeps parameter values other than 0 and 1; a suite over small values would report it NOT CAUGHT and be right to.
